recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It fixes a wrong element-name reference in the status/subjectStatus guidance path without folding in broader later R6 status-management work such as FHIR-54098 or FHIR-54491.
issue_request: FHIR-22726 was Published/Persuasive for R5. It requested Encounter guidance for period start/end timing when clinical care, discharge, billing, documentation close-out, and Encounter completion may occur at different times, and its resolution added a discharged Encounter.status plus Status Management guidance.
initial_application: FHIR-22726 was applied by d80fcb1ea0598fcaa22158a24d8db793657ccda7, which added the discharged status code/definition, added discharged to Encounter.status, and added Status Management text for administrative completion after care. Commit 5524e4a36dc7976d2dae9ca4806ec1ee9030d2b0 propagated the status-code list to the then-current statusHistory source. Current source retains those changes.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. Later work renamed Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod and added plannedStartDate/plannedEndDate, while FHIR-13702 and FHIR-32343 introduced/refined Encounter.subjectStatus as the patient-specific status companion to Encounter.status. Those decisions support the existing FHIR-22726 guidance but make the subjectState reference in Encounter.status a current-source defect.
reconciliation: Changed source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml and source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml from subjectState to subjectStatus. No other source change was needed because the discharged status, required value-set include, and Status Management guidance already implement the issue. The generated-looking source/encounter/encounter.svg still has the old text and was intentionally not edited directly.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: corrected Encounter.status definition to refer to subjectStatus.
source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: corrected the matching Event.status mapping exception resource text.
